title: NewtonJointAPI (joint-level seeds)
summary: Newton joint-level values the PhysX parser reads as seeds for every axis of a revolute, prismatic, spherical or D6 joint: velocity limit, armature, friction and damping. A PhysxJointAxisAPI value on an axis overrides them.
producer_scope: Published like any applied API when the Newton schema is registered for population; without the registration its attributes are lost (see the ovphysx Newton schema notes).

columns.name: newton:velocityLimit
columns.sentinel: A value >= FLT_MAX (inf included) is no Newton opinion; a finite legacy velocity limit may supply the fallback.
columns.absent: A finite legacy physxJoint:maxJointVelocity supplies the fallback, otherwise FLT_MAX. A finite PhysxJointAxisAPI maxJointVelocity has highest precedence.
columns.notes: Newton schema attribute (newton-usd-schemas, not shipped with ovphysx). The parser reads it on every revolute, prismatic, spherical and D6 joint without checking usd-schemas; fixed, distance, gear and rack-and-pinion joints never read it. A finite Newton value overrides the legacy joint velocity limit and seeds maxJointVelocity of every supported axis; deg_to_rad on angular axes except the unlimited sentinel.

columns.name: newton:armature
columns.absent: 0.0, unless a positive PhysxJointAxisAPI armature overrides it.
columns.notes: Newton schema attribute (newton-usd-schemas, not shipped with ovphysx). The parser reads it on every revolute, prismatic, spherical and D6 joint without checking usd-schemas; fixed, distance, gear and rack-and-pinion joints never read it. Seeds armature of every supported axis.

columns.name: newton:friction
columns.absent: 0.0 for both friction efforts, unless a positive PhysxJointAxisAPI friction effort overrides them.
columns.notes: Newton schema attribute (newton-usd-schemas, not shipped with ovphysx). The parser reads it on every revolute, prismatic, spherical and D6 joint without checking usd-schemas; fixed, distance, gear and rack-and-pinion joints never read it. Seeds both staticFrictionEffort and dynamicFrictionEffort.

columns.name: newton:damping
columns.absent: 0.0, unless a positive PhysxJointAxisAPI viscousFrictionCoefficient overrides it.
columns.notes: Newton schema attribute (newton-usd-schemas, not shipped with ovphysx). The parser reads it on every revolute, prismatic, spherical and D6 joint without checking usd-schemas; fixed, distance, gear and rack-and-pinion joints never read it. Seeds viscousFrictionCoefficient; x 180/pi on angular axes.

notes: The parser reads these columns without checking that NewtonJointAPI is listed in usd-schemas. The compiled cache reads them but does not support the API: a prim that lists NewtonJointAPI makes the cache bypass.
